title: SG-6.1.2 · BootScene emits a typed characterClick event to React
summary: Clicking an NPC in BootScene emits a typed characterClick event to React, alongside the existing interact animation.
description: Context: BootScene.createCharacter (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) plays the interact animation on pointerdown but tells React nothing. The typed bus in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts has only objectHover, objectClick and sceneReady. Desired behavior: add a characterClick event type and emit it on NPC click without changing the animation. Expected result: React subscribers receive { id } for the clicked character. Why: dialogue and interaction for NPCs (SG-6.1) needs a typed signal from Phaser.
acceptance_criteria: Given the PhaserToReactEvents interface, When characterClick is emitted with { id: 'boy' }, Then a subscribed handler receives exactly that payload once.
Given a BootScene with a character sprite, When pointerdown fires on it, Then phaserToReact emits characterClick with the character spec id.
Given a character with an interact animation, When it is clicked, Then the interact animation still plays and returns to idle.
technical_constraints: Phaser is mocked in unit tests; no browser or live server
Use the existing phaserToReact bus; no new event system
definition_of_done: characterClick is typed and emitted on NPC click
Unit tests for event type and BootScene emit pass
